Here's what me and my friends came up with after binging the seasons: 

&#x200B;

**Lisa** \- ENTJ for sure (if you watch her interact in RHOBH this becomes more obvious)  
**Stassi** \- ENTJ (soft T)  - Stassi is a soft T but when she's more stable and sure of herself, she seems to be calculating and detached like an ENTJ (no shade, I am an ENTJ).   


I think these two clash so much because often strong, controlling personality types like ENTJs don't take well to not being a leader and having to answer to others. Stassi felt in control of the group in early seasons, but clashed brutally with Lisa because she didn't like being checked. They both enjoy being in a position of power over others who are their 'friends' and prefer to have friendships where their friends are dependent and loyal (/lapdogs). Lisa with Kyle, Brandi, Teddi, etc. Stassi with early season Katie and Kristen. 

&#x200B;

**Jax** \- ENTP (soft N and T) This was contentious and hotly contested in the group chat, but we eventually came to ENTP because he is very scheming and perceptive when it comes to other people's relationships and dynamics and in particular how to manoeuvre within a group - leading towards an NT perception - but when it comes to his very close, personal relationships he is explosive and doesn't think through the consequences, which would lead some people to this he's an SF because in the moment he appears to react from his gut, which is trash. In the end, we agreed he was an ENTP due to the way he interacts in a group setting. If anyone wants to jump on this analysis I am all ears.

**James** \- ENTP - I'm more sure of this one. He uses his perceptive skills as a party trick. Because he's in an addictive breakdown mode right now, I know he can come across as something different, but especially in the earlier seasons, he behaves EXACTLY like all ENTPs I know. 

&#x200B;

ENTPs sometimes really clash too. Jax and James are both arrogant on top of that, but they hate each other for their similarities, not their differences. I'm glad they haven't formed some sort of ENTP evil squad. 

  
**Scheana** \- ESFJ   
**Brittany** \- ESFJ   
**Kristen** \- ESFP but honestly such a wild card that I can't with her. 

**Ariana** \- INTJ - I make this call because she's harsh and honestly doesn't go with groupthink. She derives all of her values from her own internal reasoning and is pretty unshakeable and stubborn regarding them. If she hates you, she hates you, and her rigid reasoning makes me think she's an INTJ. It's the rarest personality type for women and I'm honestly surprised she's ended up on the show.   
**Schwarz** \- ENFP (soft E/maybe I) I honestly couldn't make the call myself, but my friends were adamant. He's hard to read. He's a people pleaser which leads me to believe he's an E, and often times has gone above and beyond the call of duty to maintain loyalty to his group.    
**Katie** \- INFP (possible J) - internal reasoning, bullying behaviour that is reinforced by stronger social influencers in the group (P). Doesn't let go of things easily and can be very rigid in some pretty harsh calls that the group don't agree with (James, Lala), leading me to believe she *could* be IxxJ.   
**Sandoval** \- pure ESFP in my opinion. Performer with a flair for carefully planned outfits and a strong appreciation for aesthetics. Can't rein in his emotions easily and is quick to express his feelings which leads me to believe he's an SFP.  
**Lala** \- ESFP. She's always hamming it up for the camera and I don't know if that's her actual type, but the Lala Kent we see on the show (her reality TV persona) is absolutely an ESFP. She's definitely performing when she's on VPR. 

&#x200B;

VERY open to discussion about all of this  though. Great topic, OP!

I'm also curious - has there ever been an instance of a bravolebrity revealed sensitive information they weren't supposed to during a podcast that got them in trouble?

During her convo with Karl she was *so* thrilled when he was like "You're like a sister to me... that I want to have sex with." It made me cringe. She doesn't want to be with any of those guys really but she wants them to want to be with her. Why!
